subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The central skateboarder remains largely consistent across cuts: black helmet or dark headgear where visible, black shirt and pants, similar build, skateboard, and dark/purple footwear. Shot 0 and shot 5 are cropped, and shirt/footwear details vary slightly, but the same rider/event is still perceptually maintained.

background_coherent.rationale: All shots remain in the same outdoor skate bowl with tan/brown ramp surfaces, concrete flat, blue coping/fencing, trees, and painted wall sections. Viewpoint changes are coherent with moving around the same skatepark.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Low near-concrete framing and fast left-to-right roll are clear, though the rider is heavily cropped.
Side/tracking view of the rider carving across the bowl is well matched.
The ollie/trick near the lip is visible, but the angle is not clearly overhead.
Sharp turn near a painted wall is visible, but the camera is more front/side than behind the rider.
The rider crosses the bowl at speed with a longer-lens feel, though background streaking is limited.
Front three-quarter roll-out and bent-knee stabilization are plausible, but the rider is cropped at the top.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence preserves distinct framings, distances, ramp positions, and action beats rather than collapsing into repeated compositions.

motion_continuity.rationale: The sampled frames show plausible progression through rolling, carving, popping, landing, turning, and stabilizing, with strong changes in pose and board orientation.

which_cut_broke.how: No transition clearly breaks consistency; the weakest continuity points are due to cropping and modest outfit/detail drift rather than a definite subject or scene change.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are visually distinct with changing pose, board angle, camera position, and background layout; there is no evidence of copied frames, frozen motion, or collapsed prompting.
